v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dixit Dóminus * Dómino meo: Sede a dextris meis. ‡
text.en: The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand. ‡

text.la: Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.
text.en: Great are the works of the Lord, * sought out according to all his wills.

text.la: Qui timet Dóminum, * in mandátis eius cupit nimis.
text.en: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord; * he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments. ‡

text.la: Sit nomen Dómini * benedíctum in sǽcula.
text.en: Blessed be the name of the Lord * from henceforth now and for ever.

text.la: Deus autem noster * in cælo: ómnia quæcúmque vóluit, fecit.
text.en: But our God is in heaven, * he hath done all things whatsoever he would.

text.la: Benedíctus Deus, et Pater Dómini nostri Iesu Christi, Pater misericordiárum, et Deus totíus consolatiónis, qui consolátur nos in omni tribulatióne nostra.
text.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort, who comforteth us in all our tribulation.

text.la: Homo quidam * descendébat ab Ierúsalem in Iéricho et íncidit in latrónes, qui étiam despoliavérunt eum et, plagis impósitis, abiérunt semivívo relícto.
text.en: A certain man went down from Jerusalem * to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

text.la: Omnípotens et miséricors Deus, de cuius múnere venit, ut tibi a fidélibus tuis digne et laudabíliter serviátur: tríbue, quǽsumus, nobis; ut ad promissiónes tuas sine offensióne currámus.
text.en: Almighty and merciful God, of Whose only gift it cometh that thy faithful people do unto thee true and laudable service, grant, we beseech thee, that we may so faithfully serve thee in this life, that we fail not finally to attain thy heavenly promises.

office.title: Dominica XII Post Pentecosten II. Augusti
